text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Carmina, was it?
They have completely captured the hearts and minds of the people.
I am afraid that they are an obstacle on my road to world domination.
choice_data_list: Let's start our own pop group in opposition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【カルミナ】じゃったか。
見事なまでに
民草の心を掴んでおったな。
これはもしかすると、
わらわの世界征服の障害となるやもしれんな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Correct.
That Nozomi is dynamic, and appears to have the qualities of a leader.
While I still can, I should make her one of my underlings... I only jest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ。
ノゾミの奴は行動力もあって、
リーダーとしての資質もありそうじゃ。
今のうちに
わらわの配下にしてしまえば……
冗談じゃよ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will!
I shall not be defeated by the likes of them!
For, my dear minion, I have you by my side!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論じゃ！
　わらわが負けるわけがあるまい！
我が眷属よ、
お主も付いておるんじゃからな！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
What?! I never considered that!
The way you think astonishes me...
Well... regrettably, I must politely decline.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんと！
　そんな手が……！
お主の発想には驚かされるのう……
まぁ……
その案は、
丁重に却下させてもらうが。
